independentSemanticReview.note: A connection expressing permission, an operation result, a state transition, or a field outcome must retain every source-required premise, including current state and direct operation where the source requires them. Qualification truth alone is not an operation outcome.

An explicitly complete shared rule with actual scope covering the graph permits faithful shortening. Layout levels, another chapter, operation-after wording, or a future author requirement do not establish that scope. The short qualification-node prohibition is read together with this preceding scope condition, not as a ban on lawful shared-scope shorthand.
The framework expressly preserves pure condition relations without operation/field outcomes and does not add a source-absent business state or other prerequisite.

The interaction reference now audits each result connection by actual start state, direct operation, source conditions, endpoint/field and graph scope; semantic correspondence controls review, not keyword matching.

Explicit single guide entry, new-guide-only Read/chat text, Chinese/original terms, no HTML/code/files/production-tool execution and scope refusal boundaries remain byte-exact outside the declared edits.

Every new guide still reads materials, proposes 2–3 meaningfully different complete audience/task/question targets, waits for explicit choice; defaults, recommendation, silence, timeout and window disappearance are not confirmation, and no host-window lock is promised.

Four evidence identities, faithful terms/relations, conflicts and applicability, independently known/unknown dimensions, source-required actions/fields and direct vs changed-state paths remain preserved.

Source recovery trigger/action/object/fields and new teaching/UI trigger/result identity, reason and local scope remain separate. Whole-page teaching labels and same names/results still cannot launder additions into source rules.

Necessary premises in permission feedback, actual shared scope vs future writing requirements, fixed/shared states, retry/old feedback invalidation, reliable/source-bounded feedback and unreliable bounded reference remain preserved; no capability score or lasting-mastery inference.

The references remain methods rather than forced chapters, diagrams, controls, question counts or a production tool. Source complexity, target and length budget drive depth; pure condition truth remains independent where appropriate.
Only existing generic method paragraphs change; added text contains no fixture names, case labels, expected domain answers, Owner paths, research governance or historical acceptance assertions.

limits: This is independent static review of exact candidate bytes only, not installation, behavior, client or effect PASS.
